## About Me

My research focuses on **thermal biology and functional ecology**, with an interest in understanding how organisms respond and adapt to environmental variation. I integrate **morphological, physiological and genomic approaches** to investigate functional traits, environmental stress responses and their evolutionary basis.

During the last years, I used Cuban *Polymita* land snails as a **Neotropical model system**, combining the study of shell functional traits and tissue responses to acute thermal stress with the genomic characterization of molecular stress-response mechanisms. This integrative framework connects organismal phenotypes with cellular responses and gene-family evolution.

More broadly, my research interests lie at the intersection of **functional ecology, evolutionary biology and conservation**. A particular interest of mine is extending this work toward **comparative thermal biology, contrasting organisms from tropical and temperate environments to understand how different thermal regimes shape functional traits, stress responses and  adaptation**.

---

## Research Interests

* Thermal biology & thermal adaptation
* Functional & evolutionary ecology
* Ecophysiology & environmental stress
* Comparative & functional genomics 
* Biodiversity & conservation under environmental change
